1	//! Renderer implementation and utilities. The renderer is responsible for
     2	//! taking the internal screen state and turning into some output format,
     3	//! usually for a screen.
     4	//!
     5	//! The renderer is closely tied to the windowing system which usually
     6	//! has to prepare the window for the given renderer using system-specific
     7	//! APIs. The renderers in this package assume that the renderer is already
     8	//! setup (OpenGL has a context, Vulkan has a surface, etc.)
     9	
    10	const build_config = @import("build_config.zig");
    11
